name: Yamanoma
description: The capital of Yama stands majestic, fit for epic tales; its architecture is built into the slopes of Hihashiyama, as if ascending a stairway to heaven. Its districts, constructed on rising plateaus, mirror the social hierarchy of its inhabitants, with Tenshikin’s palace at the pinnacle. The city has grown and expanded recently because of economic progress, though foreign visitors are still limited. Resounding gongs mark the rhythm of activities, signaling both regular routines and special events. The high priests receive their Edicts and undertake actions to fulfill Tenshikin’s will. Although the city is generally safe, many hidden dangers lurk in the shadows, such as kitsunes, spectral ninjas, corrupted monks, and more. One interesting place in the city is the Silver Dragon Pagoda. Tenshikin allows criminals seeking redemption to undergo the test of the Silver Dragon. It is a construction that takes individuals to another plane in an immense tower of eleven floors, as large as a city. The test consists of reaching the pagoda rooftop and finding the portal to return to the Material Plane. Each floor presents a unique test, from combating unusual creatures and guardians to learning and demonstrating specific skills, and resisting temptations to act dishonorably. The challenges become progressively difficult to test the prisoner’s convictions, eventually leading them to challenge the Silver Dragon itself. Many die trying to reach the goal, but according to the few survivors, the hardest challenge is the seventh floor, the Lantern Library, capable of driving people insane. The secret of this tower is that people can be released from it through a demonstration of honor or altruism, not by defeating the challenges. Medium fey (shapechanger), any chaotic Armor Class: 13 Hit Points: 44 (8d8 + 8) Speed: 30 ft. STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (+0) 17 (+3) 12 (+1) 14 (+2) 15 (+2) 16 (+3) Skills: Deception +5, Insight +4, Perception +4, Stealth +5 Senses: darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14 Languages: Common, Sylvan Challenge: 3 (700 XP) Shapechanger. The kitsune can use its action to polymorph into a human form, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Keen Hearing and Smell. The kitsune has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell. Innate Spellcasting. The kitsune’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The kitsune can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: - At will: minor illusion - 3/day each:charm person, disguise self, illusionary script, invisibility, major image Actions Multiattack. The kitsune makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
